title: Brr Brr Patapim
blurb: Tree legs, a suspiciously detailed backstory, and a name that is simply enjoyable to say out loud. Patapim is one of the most beloved figures in the Italian brainrot universe, and the rhythm of the name is the entire reason — it works like a nursery rhyme, all percussion and no meaning, which is exactly how these things propagate. The accompanying lore is delivered with the gravity of a nature documentary, which makes it funnier rather than less funny. Play it to summon anybody under fifteen instantly, and to alarm anybody over twenty-five.
origin: An Italian brainrot AI character in the Tralalero Tralala universe.
